item.title: US House Defeats Initial Attempt to Impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth
item.description: The House of Representatives stopped an impeachment effort against Defense Secretary Hegseth. President Trump celebrated the result, though lawmakers from the opposing party may reintroduce the measure next year.

item.title: Kenyan Residents Brace for Severe Flooding as El Niño Approaches
item.description: Meteorologists predict that an unusually powerful El Niño weather pattern will bring severe rainfall and floods to Kenya. Local communities have expressed deep concern over the potential destruction.

item.title: Greta Thunberg Criticizes COP31 Climate Summit Negotiations
item.description: Activist Greta Thunberg traveled to the United Nations climate summit to urge global officials to prioritize human lives and ecological health over financial gain.

item.title: Microsoft Launches Auto SR Upscaling Tool for Xbox Ally X Handhelds
item.description: Microsoft has released its DLSS rival, Automatic Super Resolution, for the Xbox Ally X and specific Windows Copilot Plus computers, enabling upscaling functionality in handheld devices.

item.title: Florida Judge Allows Trump's $10 Billion Defamation Lawsuit Against BBC
item.description: A federal judge in Florida permitted Donald Trump's defamation complaint against the BBC to move forward. The court noted that the plaintiff adequately argued the network harmed his reputation with a selectively edited video.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth Avoids Impeachment While Iran Rejects Dialogue
item.description: An impeachment effort against Defense Secretary Hegseth was defeated despite political resistance to ongoing military actions. Meanwhile, Iranian officials rejected claims of negotiations with the United States.

item.title: Construction Sets and Stickers Boost Holiday Toy Sales Before Christmas
item.description: Toys such as building kits and stickers are boosting retail numbers during a strong sales period leading up to Christmas. This retail growth coincides with ongoing discussions regarding children and digital device usage.

item.title: Understanding Proper HDMI Port Selection for Roku Devices
item.description: While Roku devices are less demanding about specific HDMI ports compared to gaming consoles or audio equipment, proper connection selection remains important for optimal performance.

item.title: Noskova Eliminates Gauff to Secure WTA Finals Semifinal Spot
item.description: Linda Noskova defeated Coco Gauff to secure her place in the semifinals of the WTA Finals. The Wimbledon winner is the initial competitor to advance to the final four.

item.title: Study Shows Escitalopram Outperforms Prozac in Preventing Relapse
item.description: An extensive review indicates that escitalopram excels at stopping patient relapses. The medication was among three top-performing options that beat Prozac.

item.title: Poundland Seeks Urgent Buyer to Avoid Potential Collapse
item.description: The discount retailer is approaching potential administration but anticipates receiving additional time to secure a rescue agreement. Observers report ongoing efforts to find an acquirer.

item.title: Blaze Brought Under Control at Iranian South Pars Gas Platform
item.description: Authorities report that a fire at an Iranian gas facility has been suppressed. Investigators are examining an operational failure or gas escape as potential origins, according to Fars.

item.title: Jharkhand Chief Minister Orders CBI Inquiry Into Activist Death
item.description: Hemant Soren requested a federal investigation following the fatality of a tribal activist, prompting the suspension of a local station house officer. Additionally, authorities registered an FIR naming two individuals.

item.title: Palestinian Business Destroyed by Settler Fire Near Nablus
item.description: Israeli settlers ignited a blaze targeting a commercial establishment belonging to Palestinians in Luban ash-Sharqiya. The incident resulted in significant damage near Nablus.

item.title: Autonomous Vessels Deployed for Mine Detection Missions
item.description: The United States is utilizing Gulf conflict conditions to evaluate robotic craft designed for hazardous mine-clearing operations. These autonomous systems undertake high-risk underwater tasks.

item.title: Teardown Reveals Mechanism Behind Apple MacBook Glowing Logo
item.description: An examination by iFixit details the engineering of the illuminated PROLED emblem on recent Apple laptops. The hardware successfully revives the classic design element.

item.title: US House halts impeachment push against Hegseth
item.description: Lawmakers voted 211-204 to refer the impeachment motion to the Judiciary Committee, delaying the attempt. Democrats could potentially restart the process in January when they assume congressional control.

item.title: American lawmakers block motion to remove Pete Hegseth
item.description: The US House of Representatives has successfully halted a legislative attempt to impeach the war secretary.

item.title: Early access to iPad Visual Intelligence camera feature
item.description: Users can utilize the new Siri camera integration through a dedicated tab within the tablet's native camera application prior to the official public rollout.

item.title: Film 'Scene' surpasses Rs 174 crore globally in three days
item.description: Starring Suriya and Naslen, the movie earned Rs 97.40 crore net domestically before experiencing a 40% drop on day five. Its worldwide gross stands at Rs 174.40 crore toward a Rs 200 crore goal.

item.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy says he is pleased with messages from U.S. envoys on diplomatic efforts to end war
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Zelenskyy stated when asked about the recent messages by U. Key points: Ukraine, Zelenskyy, Jared Kushner, Steve Witkoff.

item.title: French far-right author Zemmour launches second bid for 2027 presidency
item.description: As reported by Al Jazeera, Zemmour seeks to expel 'foreign unemployed people' after last month's violent protests. Key points: French, Zemmour, zemmour, french.

item.title: New estimates show farm fires may be vastly undercounted in Punjab, Haryana
item.description: As reported by Hindustan Times, Winds carrying smoke toward Delhi are forecast to return Wednesday and Thursday. Key points: Punjab, Haryana An, November, Winds.

item.title: US House Rejects Effort To Impeach Defence Chief Pete Hegseth
item.description: As reported by NDTV, Republicans in the US House of Representatives on Tuesday blocked an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war, handing President Donald Trump a victory days after his party's crushing midterm election defeat. Key points: House Rejects Effort To Impeach Defence Chief Pete Hegseth Republicans, House, Representatives, Tuesday.

item.title: NVIDIA and CEO Jensen Huang Face Investor Lawsuits
item.description: Shareholders have filed lawsuits against NVIDIA and its chief executive following a significant drop in the company's stock value, which occurred after reports of an executive relationship involving an alleged Chinese intelligence operative.

item.title: Tennessee Family Wins Driveway Access But Loses City Suit
item.description: A state court ordered the removal of a fence blocking a Tennessee family's shared driveway and confirmed their easement rights. Meanwhile, a federal judge threw out a separate legal action the family had brought against the city regarding permit issues.

item.title: Tiger Woods Focuses on Supporting Son Charlie's Golf Career
item.description: Following a severe automobile accident, Tiger Woods has shifted his focus toward fatherhood by caddying for his son Charlie and supporting his athletic ambitions. Their close bond highlights a major evolution in the golfer's personal priorities over time.

item.title: Seagate Introduces New FireCuda Forge Hybrid Storage Drive
item.description: Seagate has launched the FireCuda Forge, a storage device that revives hybrid drive technology and brings back previous industry inquiries regarding its performance and utility.

item.title: Nvidia Retains US Law Firm Following CEO Investigation
item.description: Nvidia has brought on a prominent US legal firm to look into matters arising from revelations that CEO Jensen Huang had an involvement with a woman suspected of spying for China.

item.title: U.S. Army member arrested in U.K. for alleged Russian links
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, K. authorities stated the investigation was not linked to other ongoing counterterrorism investigations. Key points: Army, Russian, member, arrested.

item.title: English Couple Denied Ownership of Neighbor's Garden Strip
item.description: A First-tier Tribunal rejected a claim by Dr. Piers Connor and Professor Christine Pasquire to legally acquire a narrow strip of neighboring land used as a driveway. The tribunal ruled that the applicants failed to meet the requirements for adverse possession.

item.title: Man Arrested in Mathura for Alleged Rape and Filming
item.description: Police in Mathura district arrested a man on Tuesday for allegedly raping a woman and recording the assault on his phone. Authorities stated the suspect had promised to help the victim obtain housing through a government scheme.

item.title: Transfer Rumors: Arsenal Tracks Endrick and Newcastle Eyes Beljo
item.description: Arsenal is reportedly monitoring Real Madrid attacker Endrick. Meanwhile, Jeremie Frimpong will remain at Liverpool, and both Newcastle United and Sunderland are showing interest in Croatian forward Dion Beljo.

item.title: Testing SCSKiller and Its Impact on PC Game Shader Stutters
item.description: A complimentary software application promises to eliminate shader compilation stutter in contemporary computer games. Tests were conducted on software known for severe performance stutters to evaluate its actual effectiveness.

item.title: Six Flags Agrees to $11.2M Settlement Over Online Ticket Fees
item.description: Six Flags settled an 11.2 million dollar class-action lawsuit regarding undisclosed online processing fees. California residents who bought tickets from mid-2020 through mid-2024 can submit claims to receive eight dollars.

item.title: Moscow Expels Moldovan Envoy in Reciprocal Diplomatic Action
item.description: Russia has expelled a diplomat from Moldova in a retaliatory measure. Diplomatic ties between the two nations have deteriorated following the launch of Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

item.title: Iran Urges Washington to Choose Diplomacy Over Military Force
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that the ongoing conflict cannot be settled by military action or increased sanctions. He urged the United States to fulfill Iranian conditions to stop the hostilities.

item.title: US Indicts Three Men Over Alleged Terror Plots Linked to Iran
item.description: United States prosecutors have charged three individuals with plotting attacks against Jewish populations and a British airbase. The security concerns at RAF Fairford led to the relocation of American bombers stationed there.

item.title: গুলশানে স্লোগান দেওয়ার অভিযোগে তিন যুবক পুলিশে সোপর্দ
item.description: রাজধানীর গুলশানে প্রধানমন্ত্রীর বাসভবনের কাছে রাজনৈতিক স্লোগান দেওয়ার অভিযোগে তিনজনকে আটক করে পুলিশের কাছে হস্তান্তর করেছেন ছাত্রদলের এক নেতা। এ সময় মোটরসাইকেল নিয়ে আরও চারজন পালিয়ে যান।

item.title: US Military Expresses Growing Concern Over Space Launch Capacity
item.description: American defense officials are showing increased anxiety regarding limitations in available rocket launch capabilities. Experts noted that this severe launch bottleneck aligns with prior forecasts.

item.title: US House Republicans Halt Pete Hegseth Impeachment Bid
item.description: Republican lawmakers in the US House have stopped an effort to impeach Pete Hegseth. The move followed accusations that he led an unauthorized military campaign against Iran.

item.title: US Files Charges Against Three Over UK Airbase Plot
item.description: American authorities have indicted Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi, Mohsen Mohajeri, and Mohammad Ali al-Hassani. They are accused of orchestrating a September attack at RAF Fairford in Britain.

item.title: Thomas Markle Detained Again After Tampering With Monitor
item.description: Thomas Markle, 82, returned to federal custody in Florida. Authorities state he allegedly removed his electronic ankle monitor following house arrest charges related to child sex abuse material.

item.title: Delhi Smog Driven Mostly by Fireworks on Monday
item.description: Firecrackers accounted for four-fifths of Delhi's air pollution levels on Monday. Officials confirmed the heavy concentration of smog was largely due to festive celebrations.

item.title: Certain Xiaomi Devices Excluded From HyperOS 4 Upgrade
item.description: Older Xiaomi smartphones will miss out on the HyperOS 4 software release. The new firmware introduces memory enhancements and Soft Light Glass elements to supported hardware.

item.title: Three Iranian Nationals Charged Over UK Airbase Attack
item.description: The US government has filed charges against Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi, Mohsen Mohajeri, and Mohammad Ali al-Hassani. They allegedly directed a September incident at RAF Fairford, a facility utilized by American forces for Iran operations.

item.title: Feyi-Waboso Compared to Jason Robinson by Sinfield
item.description: Coach Kevin Sinfield likened injured player Immanuel Feyi-Waboso to World Cup champion Jason Robinson. The assistant coach highlighted his importance for the squad.

item.title: Teddy Riner Enters French Presidential Race Amid Crises
item.description: Judo champion Teddy Riner has announced his bid for the French presidency during a period of economic and social turmoil. Commentators view his candidacy as an alternative to figures like Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

item.title: Bihar Chief Minister Penalizes Fifteen Officials for Dereliction
item.description: Fifteen government officials in Bihar faced suspension due to professional negligence. The disciplined personnel belong to four distinct administrative divisions, including the Revenue and Land Reforms Department.

item.title: Thomas Markle Arrested Again After Tampering With Ankle Tag
item.description: Federal authorities in Tampa, Florida, detained Thomas Markle following the removal of his monitoring device. A US attorney confirmed he is currently held pending a court appearance.

item.title: Amazon Announces Autonomous Ring Security Drones and Robots
item.description: Amazon unveiled new mobile security devices under its Ring brand, powered by artificial intelligence. These robotic units are scheduled for release between late 2026 and early 2027.

item.title: Bombay High Court Denies Permit for Chhath Puja at Beach
item.description: The judiciary rejected a request to host Chhath Puja celebrations at Girgaon Chowpatty. Judges cited constitutional limitations regarding religious freedoms concerning public order, morality, and health.

item.title: Fossil Reports Sales Growth as Turnaround Exceeds Schedule
item.description: The watch manufacturer announced on Tuesday that its recovery plan is progressing faster than anticipated. Leadership confirmed that the firm is moving back toward profitability and increasing sales.

item.title: UNIFIL Patrol Targeted by Gunfire in Southern Lebanon
item.description: Peacekeepers in Lebanon reported that approximately twelve shots were directed at their patrol unit on Tuesday. The organization did not specify who was responsible for the attack.

item.title: US Survey Shows Majority No Longer Backs Capital Punishment
item.description: Public approval for the death penalty dropped below fifty percent in a recent US poll for the first time since 1971. This shift follows years of declining support linked to worries over fairness and racial prejudice.

item.title: Actor Tommy Lee Jones Settles Into Texas Ranch Life at Eighty
item.description: Oscar-winning performer Tommy Lee Jones has transitioned to a private lifestyle on his vast Texas property alongside his spouse. At eighty years old, he manages a six-thousand-acre estate featuring numerous horses and polo fields.

item.title: Delhi High Court Told Centre Has No Club Allotment Plans
item.description: The central government informed the Delhi High Court that there are no current plans to transfer the Central Secretariat club property to any outside party.

item.title: Iranian Officials Criticize France Following Cyber Incident
item.description: Tehran has ridiculed Paris over a recent digital attack targeting French supermarkets, pointing to difficulties in handling basic infrastructure.

item.title: Tea Producers Support Minimum Sustainable Price Initiative
item.description: The Tea Board of India suggested setting a minimum sustainable price to the Commerce Ministry. Industry participants noted this measure is vital for sector viability.

item.title: IBM Unit Halts Most US Visas for Overseas Staff
item.description: The primary division of IBM is stopping most sponsorship applications for skilled foreign personnel in the US. This decision follows recent visa restrictions by the Trump administration.
